scope: Proposition 4.2 (Projection and stratum tests) of the manuscript “Global quantum geometric Langlands at irrational level” (preprints/Global-quantum-geometric-Langlands-at-irrational-level-October-4-2026/quantum-langlands.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 069 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8d9bc135865dbc97), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 26. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In every pole bound, inclusion of the strongly Whittaker category has a continuous right adjoint Av∗. Its image consists exactly of the objects F satisfying 1. f! DF = 0 on every irrelevant stratum; 2. on a relevant stratum, f! DF = Exp(ψD) ⊗! q! DED for an object ED in the D-module category of SD with its induced twist. The analogous statement uses −ψD for the opposite character. Restriction by ! computes the projection on each stratum. These projections commute with !-base change in the parameter schemes and with tensoring a spectator category. They are compatible with !-restriction between pole bounds. Closed direct images, both between pole bounds and along closed parameter embeddings, preserve the Whittaker subcategories. If a bounded-zero open contains every relevant stratum of a pole bound, restriction to that open and star extension identify its Whittaker category with that of the entire bound.
